areaDescription: Behind its neatly ordered facades and painted signs, this town district hums with the careful bustle of traders, scribes, and artisans who guard their secrets as jealously as their ledgers. By dusk, lantern light gleams on polished stone and narrow alleys, where a wrong turn can lead to a locked door, a silent watcher, or trouble best left uninvited.

map.notes: Extended schema with AI-friendly navigation fields

locations.name: Curator's Reliquary
locations.description: A polished storefront tucked between ledger houses, Curator's Reliquary trades in sealed curios, legal relics, and carefully authenticated oddities. Brass cases line the walls beneath painted signs promising provenance, discretion, and no questions asked in the wrong order.

npcs.name: Arannis, vault scholar and alarmed archivist
npcs.description: A pale, meticulous scholar who uses the shop's back counter to cross-check relic marks against older Numillian records. He is anxious, observant, and very careful about who hears what he knows.

lootTable: Sealed curiosity box containing 1d4 x 10 gp in mixed coinage
Map scrap showing a discreet route toward the Hall of First Trials
Ink-signed provenance tag worth 25 gp to collectors
Minor charm of preservation (one use to keep an object fresh for 24 hours)
plotHooks: Arannis quietly asks the party to verify whether a recently sold ward-token was forged.
A coded receipt suggests a hidden transfer from this shop to the Curated Districts watch routes.
One display case contains a false bottom leading to a note naming a witness in danger.
locations.dmInstructions: This shop is part of The Hidden City of Numillian. Use it as a low-stakes entry point into the district's secrets. Arannis can provide lore, rumors, and a lead to the first trial without revealing the deeper crisis too early.

doors.name: Front Door
doors.description: A lacquered cedar door with a brass bell and a painted sign listing shop rules in three languages.

doors.name: Backroom Door
doors.description: A reinforced interior door with a narrow viewing slit and archive stamps along the frame.

dcChecks: Investigation DC 13: Notice the false-bottom case and recover the hidden receipt.
Insight DC 14: Determine Arannis is withholding one name out of fear, not mistrust.
Persuasion DC 15: Convince Arannis to share the route to the next district.
locations.accessibility: Normal street access through the Curated Quarter; discreet backroom access is restricted and observed.

features.name: Merchandise Displays
features.description: Glass-fronted shelves of relics, tokens, and sealed oddities arranged with obsessive symmetry.

features.name: Counter
features.description: A polished counter with ledger grooves, ink wells, and a concealed drawer for sensitive transactions.

features.name: Backroom Storage
features.description: A cramped archive room packed with tagged crates, wrapped statuary fragments, and coded receipts.

encounters: A polite but tense exchange over provenance can escalate into a verbal standoff if the party presses too hard.
A forged relic is revealed as evidence of someone moving false tokens through the district.
locations.adventureSummary: A reputable front for Numillian's hidden trade, where the party can gather clues, buy specialized gear, and learn that the district's quiet commerce is entangled with the vault crisis.

locations.name: Veiled Residence
locations.description: This narrow residence looks ordinary from the street, but every shutter is aligned, every planter is numbered, and the inside smells faintly of wax and old paper. It belongs to a family that values privacy, yet its careful order hides a life constrained by surveillance and fear.

npcs.name: Kobe, endangered key witness
npcs.description: A guarded resident who has seen enough of the vault crisis to become a target. Kobe is cautious, exhausted, and terrified that speaking plainly will endanger everyone nearby.

npcs.name: Kobe, guarded resident tied to the vault
npcs.description: The same household figure, known locally for keeping strict routines and refusing visitors. He is under pressure from unseen factions and knows more than he admits.

lootTable: Hidden compartment key wrapped in wax cloth
Family ledger with names crossed out in blue ink
2d6 sp and a small ivory seal stamp
Scrap of warded parchment bearing a location hint toward the Hall of First Trials
plotHooks: Kobe can identify a symbol linking the district's trades to the vault descents.
A concealed note under a floorboard names a Wardkeeper who can be trusted.
The residence contains evidence that someone has been listening from the neighboring roofs.
locations.dmInstructions: This is a vulnerable roleplay location. Protect Kobe's importance and let the tension come from surveillance, not immediate combat. If the party offers safety, Kobe should provide a major lead into the larger Numillian plot.

doors.name: Street Door
doors.description: A plain painted door with a narrow peephole and a sliding privacy latch.

doors.name: Cellar Hatch
doors.description: A floor hatch reinforced with iron bands and sealed with waxed twine.
doors.trap: A whisper-thread alarm rings in the next alley if opened without first loosening the wax seal.

traps.name: Whisper-Thread Alarm
traps.damage: No damage; alerts nearby watchers and draws attention within 1 minute.

dcChecks: Investigation DC 12: Find the hidden compartment in the floorboards.
Insight DC 15: Read Kobe's fear and learn which question is too dangerous to ask directly.
Stealth DC 14: Enter or leave without alerting the roof watchers.
locations.accessibility: Accessible by invitation or by forcing entry; the residence is under quiet observation and the cellar is booby-trapped against intrusion.

features.name: Dust
features.description: Fine dust gathers along the baseboards, untouched except where someone recently searched the room.

features.name: Signs Of Age
features.description: Creaking floorboards and faded wall paint suggest a home long maintained but rarely repaired.

features.name: Interesting Architecture
features.description: Hidden compartments and a cramped service corridor make the house feel larger than it appears.

encounters: A tense interview with Kobe can reveal the first direct warning about the vault crisis.
Shadowed observers outside may flee, leaving behind a clue or pursue the party if noticed.
locations.adventureSummary: A private household turned pressure point, where a frightened witness can be protected, questioned, or endangered as the party uncovers the human cost of Numillian's secrecy.

locations.name: Sealed Threshold
locations.description: A ceremonial gate of pale stone and lacquered wood that marks a controlled passage deeper into the Curated Quarter. Its carved panels depict hands exchanging keys, ledgers, and veils, while ward-lines glimmer faintly at dusk.

npcs.name: Veyrun, a Wardkeeper captain
npcs.description: A disciplined officer overseeing passage through the district's controlled routes. Veyrun is practical, sharp-eyed, and torn between duty to secrecy and concern that the city's barriers are becoming dangerous to maintain.

lootTable: Ward-pass token granting limited access to restricted streets
Stamped route permit to the Veilwood Approach
Silvered chalk used to mark safe paths through illusion wards
1d4 healing potions kept in a patrol cache
plotHooks: Veyrun can authorize travel toward VA001 if convinced the party is acting in Numillian's interest.
The gate's ward-lines flicker in response to the vault crisis, hinting that the city is under strain.
A patrol log mentions an unregistered movement toward the lower descents.
locations.dmInstructions: This gate is a controlled transition point. Use it to move the party from the Curated Quarter into VA001. Veyrun should be a credible authority figure who can provide orders, warnings, and a crucial gate permit if the party earns trust.

doors.name: Main Gate
doors.description: A double-leaf gate of lacquered wood banded with pale stone ribs and warded hinges.

traps.name: Ward-Spark Sigil
traps.damage: 2d8 psychic damage and the target is pushed 10 feet back by a burst of force.

dcChecks: Persuasion DC 15: Convince Veyrun to issue a passage token.
Arcana DC 14: Identify the ward-spark pattern before it triggers.
History DC 13: Recall the old exchange protocol used by Numillian gatekeepers.
locations.accessibility: Open only during supervised passage or with proper authorization; the gate is otherwise sealed to casual traffic.

features.name: Interesting Architecture
features.description: Carved exchange motifs and hidden channels for ward-light make the gate both decorative and functional.

features.name: Watch Platform
features.description: A narrow platform above the gate gives Wardkeepers a clear view of the approaches and alleys.

encounters: A formal inspection tests the party's credentials and motives.
A brief ward malfunction can force quick thinking before the gate seal destabilizes.
locations.adventureSummary: The district's controlled exit, where authority, secrecy, and magical enforcement converge to determine whether the party may proceed into the Veilwood Approach.

locations.name: Silent Ward Barracks
locations.description: A clean, severe barracks where Wardkeepers sleep in rotation and keep their gear hung in perfect order. The common hall is quiet even at midday, broken only by the scratch of quills, the clack of practice blades, and the occasional murmur of someone reciting protocol from memory.

npcs.name: Shuluth, the hidden manipulator
npcs.description: An unseen strategist working through intermediaries, records, and quiet pressure. Within the barracks, Shuluth's influence is felt as missing reports, altered orders, and a chilling sense that someone has anticipated every move.

npcs.name: Shuluth, ancient mind-warder of Numillian
npcs.description: A terrifyingly old intelligence anchored in the city's ward tradition, present here through layered projections, dreams, or psychic echoes. Its voice is calm, immense, and impossible to fully trust.

monsters: 1 invisible stalker or equivalent ward-bound guardian
lootTable: Confiscated ledger page naming a secret passage
Wardkeeper insignia that grants advantage on one local social check
Encoded command strip leading toward the lower vault descents
plotHooks: A missing report links the barracks to altered orders issued under Shuluth's influence.
The training hall contains a psychic residue that can reveal where the hidden manipulator has been operating.
A sealed command strip points toward deeper areas of Numillian.
locations.dmInstructions: This is a high-tension location with both social and psychic danger. Shuluth should never feel like a simple physical NPC; present the hidden manipulator through whispers, projections, possessed documents, or telepathic pressure. Keep the ancient mind-warder distinctly separate in tone: vast, old, and unsettling rather than merely villainous.

doors.name: Barracks Main Door
doors.description: A reinforced oak door with a barred interior and a polished brass protocol plate.

doors.name: Records Room Door
doors.description: A narrow iron-banded door with a wax-sealed slot for official entries.
doors.trap: A psychic chime marks the intruder's mind for the next sentry to notice.

traps.name: Psychic Chime Seal
traps.damage: 3d6 psychic damage and disadvantage on the next Stealth check made within the barracks.

dcChecks: Investigation DC 15: Identify the altered orders and trace their source.
Insight DC 16: Sense whether a statement is coming from a living person or a psychic echo.
Arcana DC 17: Disrupt the psychic chime without alerting the entire barracks.
locations.accessibility: Open to authorized Wardkeepers and vetted visitors; otherwise watched and difficult to enter unnoticed.

features.name: Dust
features.description: Despite the constant cleaning, dust lingers in corners where ward-light does not reach.

features.name: Interesting Architecture
features.description: The hall is arranged for rapid response, with sightlines, weapon racks, and sealed archive alcoves integrated into the design.

features.name: Training Floor
features.description: A marked practice space shows signs of recent drills interrupted by sudden psychic distress.

encounters: The party may be questioned by Wardkeepers while trying to uncover the source of the altered orders.
A psychic surge can manifest as hostile whispers, false memories, or a brief ward-guardian attack.
locations.adventureSummary: A disciplined military space hiding a deeper intelligence, where the party confronts the shadow of Shuluth's manipulation and gains evidence of the crisis spreading beneath Numillian.
